notes.r1025_gene_function: YALI1F28274g; native gene symbol unverified; Nce103-like beta-carbonic anhydrase candidate catalyzing reversible CO2 hydration; function candidate based on AlphaFold prediction, homology and automatic annotation; experimental validation required.
notes.r1025_model_interpretation: User-authorized provisional enzymatic nuclear bicarbonate formation. The model GPR is assigned; native nuclear catalysis is not experimentally confirmed. This does not assign a gene to a separately measured spontaneous reaction.
notes.r1025_alphafold_provenance: Reused sequence-identical AF-A0A1H6PNW2-F1; AlphaFold Monomer v2.0 pipeline, file v6, created 2022-06-01, retrieved 2026-09-11 UTC; 222 residues; mean pLDDT 94.49, mean PAE 4.40 A, maximum PAE 29 A; no new AlphaFold prediction in this assignment.
notes.r1025_evidence_limits: AlphaFold structure and similarity to experimental beta-carbonic anhydrase support a function candidate, not native nuclear localization, oligomeric activity or sufficient catalytic capacity. The yeast homolog has GFP nuclear and independent mitochondrial intermembrane-space localization evidence; cross-species localization is not confirmation in Yarrowia. Native target activity and localization require experimental validation.
